title: Array.make_matrix 0 max_int returns where Invalid_argument is documented
summary: `Array.make_matrix 0 max_int 0` returns an empty matrix, where the documentation says `Invalid_argument` for a dimension greater than `Sys.max_array_length`. `Array.init_matrix 0 max_int` and `Bytes.extend b min_int max_int` also return where `Invalid_argument` is documented.
